Name: Easier Totems
Author: Preachie
Description:
[size=3]This mod aims to make crafting warp and rain totems easier. This also changed unlock requirements for the recipes.

[/size][size=5][b]Unlock Requirements[/b][/size][size=3]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Warp Totem: Farm Recipe changed from [i][b]Foraging 8 to Foraging 3.[/b][/i][/size]
[*][size=3]Warp Totem[i]: [/i]Mountains Recipe changed from [i][b]Foraging 7 to Foraging 5.[/b][/i][/size]
[*][size=3]Warp Totem: Desert Recipe trade requirement changed from [i][b]10 Iridium Bars to 5 Coconuts[/b].[/i][/size]
[*][size=3]Rain Totem Recipe unlock requirement changed from [b][i]Foraging 9 to Foraging 7.[/i][/b][/size]
[/list]
[quote]I haven't touched Warp Totem: Beach yet since the crafting recipe looks fine to me. You can give me idea what to change from it.[/quote][size=5][b]Configuration
[/b][/size][size=3]You can individually toggle on or off each changes to the totem. I recommend using [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12467]GMCM[/url].[/b]
There is also an option for Rain Totem where you can select if you'll need 1 redmushroom or 25 Fibers.
Warp Totem: Mountains option also allows you to select if you want to use 1 common mushroom or 1 copper bar.[/size]
[list]
[size=5][b]
Install[/b][/size][/list][list]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
[*]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
